In [[group theory]], a '''widget''' is a [[Subgroup|subgroup]] with a [[Missing page]].

A widget is a special case of a [[Gizmo]].

== Statement ==
{{Main|Widget theorem}}
{{Math theorem|name=Widget lemma|math_statement=Each widget has an [[Order (group theory)|order]], see [[#Proof]] and [[#Nowhere]].}}

== Proof ==
By [[Lagrange's theorem (group theory)#Statement|Lagrange's theorem]], the [[Coset#Nowhere|coset]] count divides it. This is {{EquationNote|1}}.
{{NumBlk|:|<math>a=b</math>|{{EquationRef|1}}}}
